welcome.title: IntelyIDE
welcome.heading: Welcome to IntelyIDE
welcome.tagline: Work on several Git repositories in one window. Nothing is committed or pushed unless you do it.
welcome.openHint: A Git repository becomes a one-repository workspace
welcome.scanHint: Find every Git repository below a folder
welcome.recentEmpty: No workspaces yet. Open a folder to start.
welcome.drop: Drop folders here to open them
welcome.dropActive: Drop to open as a workspace
welcome.dropFile: Drop a folder, not a file.
welcome.safeBody: Opening a folder only reads it. Agents never commit or push. Every commit and push is your click, and pushes to live branches ask you to type the branch name.
welcome.safeReadOnly: Read-only mode is on (INTELY_READONLY): commits, pushes and every other change are refused.
welcome.safeTestJail: Test mode: changes are only allowed inside the test fixture folder.
welcome.recent.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}" from the list? Your folders are not touched.
welcome.problem.newer: The workspace list was written by a newer version of IntelyIDE.
welcome.problem.legacy: The old workspace.json could not be read and was left untouched.
welcome.problem.io: The workspace list could not be read: {reason}
welcome.problem.detail: Technical detail (from the parser, English only):
ws.migrated: Your workspace was moved to the new workspace list.
